acceptance_gates: every input file's sha256 equals the one recorded here
definition.availability: first session whose close-based decision may use the amendment (accepted before 16:00 New York time: that session; otherwise the next); amendment forms are 10-K/A, 10-Q/A, 10-KT/A, 10-QT/A from the SEC Financial Statement Data Sets registry; NaN before the firm has any original periodic report

categories.core: classifiable amendment with revenue, net income, assets, liabilities, equity or operating cash flow differing by > 1% from the previous version
categories.other_changed: classifiable, not core, with some canonical key differing by > 0.1%
categories.unchanged: classifiable with no canonical key differing by > 0.1%
categories.unclass: no previous version with comparable facts

controls.full: all 76 point-in-time features of the rich panel (ranks) plus the three reporting controls

decision.FRAGILE: H1 Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 with negative sign AND R1 passes AND at least one of R2 to R7 fails
decision.INCONCLUSIVE: R1 fails: too few treated firms to conclude anything
decision.NOT_REPLICATED: R1 passes and neither SURVIVES, FRAGILE nor REVERSED applies: H1 adjusted p >= 0.05, or the sign is positive without two-sided p < 0.05
decision.REVERSED: R1 passes, H1 is not significant in the registered direction, and the H1 coefficient is POSITIVE with two-sided wild-cluster p < 0.05 (the opposite sign to the registered hypothesis; descriptive, uncorrected, no gate applies)
decision.SURVIVES: H1 Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 with negative sign AND R1 to R7 all pass

definition.economics: the frozen EXP-010B 21-session portfolio (B1) at 10 bp for M0 and M1 on the mid-sample daily panel; reported at 10, 30 and 50 bp; not part of the decision

hypotheses.H1: coefficient on core_730 < 0 (with other_730, unchanged_730 and unclass_730 as separate regressors)
hypotheses.correction: Holm across H1 and H2 on the wild-cluster bootstrap p-values (one-sided, negative)

inference.also_reported: Cameron-Gelbach-Miller two-way (firm, date) t statistic and firm-clustered t, which are not used for decisions
inference.primary: wild-cluster bootstrap over firms, null imposed, Webb six-point weights

interpretation_diagnostic.anticipation_ratio: coef(core_next365) / coef(core_prev365) from one regression with the five event-time bins; below 0.5 the association is labelled TIME_SPECIFIC, otherwise MARKER_OF_PERSISTENT_TROUBLE (it is not an information event but a marker)

arms.G0: boosted trees on the 76 features, 3 seeds, frozen EXP-010A settings
arms.M0: ridge on the 76 point-in-time features (alpha 10, the pre-existing configuration)
arms.M1: M0 plus the amendment block (core_730, other_730, unchanged_730, unclass_730 indicators and log1p count of any_730)

placebos.permute: the block permuted across firms within date (5 seeds)
placebos.shift: the block taken from 252 sessions earlier within firm

machine_learning_increment.search: none: no hyperparameter is chosen on any data, so no selection correction is needed
machine_learning_increment.test: paired mean Rank IC difference on identical dates, Newey-West HAC (4 lags), moving-block bootstrap (block 6, 4,000 draws), Holm across ridge and boosted contrasts; folds: the 8 recorded folds

outcome.label: fwd_rank_21
outcome.note: centred cross-sectional rank of the 21-session forward return within the universe-date; identical construction to every earlier experiment

prior_evidence.consequence: The sign of the effect is not settled for amendments in the XBRL era. H1 keeps its registered one-sided direction (the discovery sample's), the label REVERSED reports the opposite sign when the data support it, and S11 shows where in time after the amendment any effect sits.
prior_evidence.persistent_firm_type: Ghosh et al. report that 79% of firms with a material weakness report another in the next quarter (6% unconditionally) and Zhu (2026, SSRN, abstract level) that filing-timeliness signals work through the cross-sectional level and not through a firm's own deviations: both are the reason SURVIVES requires the within-firm gate R7.
prior_evidence.sign_is_contested: Frieder and Shanthikumar (2008, SSRN 1106855, read in full): after press-release restatement announcements by NYSE firms 1993-2002 no significant negative drift, and a significant POSITIVE return in trading days 64-126 (+4.3% raw, +5.0% characteristic-adjusted; days 127-252 insignificant). Gondhalekar et al. (2012, abstract level) report negative abnormal returns in each of four years; Moon, Lee and Waggle (2019/2020, abstract level) long-run underperformance; Hong, Lee, Park and Patro (2021/2023, abstract level) no drift where cash-flow news dominates; Ghosh et al. (2025/2026, text read in part): material-weakness disclosures are followed by negative drift over 60 to 120 trading days.

definition.question: Do value-changing amendments to periodic reports predict lower next-month return ranks in firms the discovery never saw, beyond established characteristics and reporting controls?
definition.registry_availability: EDGAR submissions registry; event date = later of the filing date and the date of the acceptance stamp; usable from the first session after the event date; the registry stamp itself is not trusted (clock audit)

registry_treatments.i402_730: 8-K reporting Item 4.02 (non-reliance on previously issued financial statements) with event date in the trailing 730 days
registry_treatments.nonfsds_amend_730: periodic-report amendment in the EDGAR registry that is not in the Financial Statement Data Sets (no financial statements: Part III, exhibits)
registry_treatments.nt_730: NT 10-K or NT 10-Q (late-filing notice) in the trailing 730 days

robustness_gates.R1_power: at least 40 distinct treated firms and 150 treated firm-dates for core_730 in the confirmatory sample, else the result is INCONCLUSIVE and nothing is concluded
robustness_gates.R2_influence: after removing the 5 treated firms whose deletion moves the coefficient most, the coefficient is still negative and at least 50% of the full-sample estimate
robustness_gates.R3_years: the coefficient is negative in at least 9 of the 12 leave-one-calendar-year-out fits (2014 and 2025 are partial years)
robustness_gates.R4_full_controls: with the full control set the coefficient is negative with wild-cluster one-sided p < 0.05
robustness_gates.R5_time_separate: in the time-separate sample (label-free counts before registration: 9 treated firms for core_730, 58 for any_730) the coefficient on any_730 is negative with wild-cluster one-sided p < 0.10 and the coefficient on core_730 is negative
robustness_gates.R6_sector: the coefficient is negative in at least 8 of the 12 leave-one-sector-out fits
robustness_gates.R7_within_firm: with a fixed effect per firm added (only the timing of the amendment within a firm identifies the coefficient) the coefficient is negative with wild-cluster one-sided p < 0.05

samples.confirmatory: mid-liquidity universe (ranks 251-1,000 by 3-month median dollar volume, close >= 5, non-ETF), identity-trusted rows, company never in the frozen 250-name universe, 2014-04-01..2025-05-09
samples.time_separate: frozen 250-name panel, identity-trusted rows, 2014-04-01..2017-03-31 (never evaluated before)

secondary_analyses.S1: core amendment in the trailing 365 days
secondary_analyses.S10: amendments that carry no financial statements
secondary_analyses.S11: age of the most informative past core amendment: four non-overlapping indicators for a core amendment first usable 0-89, 90-179, 180-364 or 365-729 calendar days before the decision day (they sum to core_730), in one regression with the other three categories; coefficients and wild-cluster p-values on both sides, descriptive
secondary_analyses.S12: H1 re-estimated separately in the more liquid and the less liquid half of the confirmatory sample (split at the date median of the 21-day dollar-volume rank), descriptive
secondary_analyses.S2: core amendment in the trailing 1,095 days
secondary_analyses.S7: H1 with the out-of-sample ridge score held fixed
secondary_analyses.S9: core amendment with Item 4.02 and late-filing notices as competing indicators

definition.status: CONFIRMATORY TEST ON AN INDEPENDENT FIRM SAMPLE - HOLDOUT SEALED - PROMOTION NOT ASSESSED

trial_ledger.model_fits: 24 ridge/boosted fits plus 5 placebo permutations x 2 arms
